title: Tubing Set Values by Air Path — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns
content:
# Tubing Set Values by Air Path — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns

**Valuation table.** When a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request, the tubing among its used accessories is valued at Summit Ridge self-pay prices according to the air path recorded on the patient's active **PAP Supply Replenishment Program** enrollment:

| Active enrollment: tubing | Active enrollment: humidifier in use | Tubing value | USD |
|---|---|---|---|
| heated tubing | yes | heated set — heated tubing and water chamber | 63.00 |
| standard tubing | yes | standard set — tubing and water chamber | 39.00 |
| heated tubing | no | standard tubing | 15.00 |
| standard tubing | no | standard tubing | 15.00 |
| no active enrollment | — | standard tubing | 15.00 |

**In words.** Heated tubing with the humidifier in use is valued as the heated set of heated tubing and water chamber at 63.00 USD; standard tubing with the humidifier in use as the standard set of tubing and water chamber at 39.00 USD; any other combination at the standard tubing value of 15.00 USD.

**Where the air path is read.** From the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment in status active: its heated-tubing indicator (heated tubing rather than standard tubing) and its humidifier-in-use indicator.

**Case (hypothetical).** A patient's active enrollment records heated tubing but the humidifier not in use: the tubing is valued at 15.00, since only heated tubing together with the humidifier in use is valued as the heated set.
